description: German national open data portal (GovData) is an open data portal listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by GovData. GovData is the German national open data portal (GovData). This harvest searched it with about 40 infrastructure phrases and read 6,582 datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water or digital network, asset or facility are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (statistics, survey tables, environment, marine science, planning, culture ... Coverage: Germany. 6,582 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 586 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
